public_service.row_semantics: One row per offense charge within a crime incident; multiple rows can share a common incident number.
public_service.privacy_generalization: Locations are reported at the nearest intersection to protect privacy.

primary_contract.method: Use census_block_2020_geoid when present as the primary spatial assignment key. Resolve that block GEOID to the containing 2020 block group. Only when census_block_2020_geoid is missing should the packet consider the generalized point geometry and nearest_intersection fields as fallback evidence.

recommended_fallback_hierarchy.notes: This is the strongest public Detroit geography because it pins the incident to a specific 2020 census block despite the nearest-intersection privacy generalization.
Use only when census_block_2020_geoid is missing. Coordinates are generalized to nearest intersection and should be treated as lower-confidence fallback geography.
Nearest intersection is useful for packet QA and plausibility checks, not as a primary national production join key.

current_packet_rule.impact: Detroit should prefer census_block_2020_geoid as the packet-local assignment basis and treat generalized point geometry only as fallback. This keeps the packet aligned with the strongest available public Detroit geography.
